name: XPENG
summary:
XPENG develops humanoid robots alongside its electric-vehicle and physical-AI activities. Its IRON platform combines a human-shaped body, dexterous manipulation and onboard intelligence, applying the company's experience in AI, computing and hardware engineering to physical tasks beyond driving.

The next-generation IRON program focuses on coordinated movement, interaction and useful work in human environments. XPENG has described commercial-service and industrial exploration, including cooperation with Baosteel on applications such as inspection. Its robotics strategy connects learned perception and action with complete-machine development, using practical validation to expand the range of tasks the platform can address.
